subject: general
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

His family lives in Bihar but he works on a factory in Mumbai.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****on a factory​.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The part 'on a factory​' is incorrect as it is grammatically incorrect.
 
• We use **on** when something resting upon or atop something else.
 
 
• **Example**: *The books are **on** the table.*
 
 
 
• We use **in** when something inside or enclosed by something else.
 
 
• **Example**: *Clothes are **in** the cupboard.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the use of 'on a factory​.' in the sentence should be replaced with 'in a factory​.' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Thus, the correct option is 'on a factory​.'
 
• ​​The correct sentence__: *His family lives in Bihar but he works** in a factory** in Mumbai.*

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• For can be used with all tenses.

 
 
• Example: *They study for two hours every day.

 They are studying for three hours today.

 He has lived in Bangkok for a long time.

 He has been living in Paris for three months.*
 
 
 
• Since is normally used with perfect tenses.
 
 
• Example: *He has been here since 9 am.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• भाग 'on a factory​' गलत है क्योंकि यह व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है।
 
• हम **on** का उपयोग तब करते हैं जब कोई चीज किसी और चीज पर टिकी होती है या उसके ऊपर होती है।
 
 
• Example: *The books are on the table.*​
 
 
 
• *​*हम **in **तब उपयोग करते हैं जब कुछ अंदर या किसी और चीज से घिरा होता है।
 
 
• Example: *Clothes are in the cupboard.*
 
 
 
• इसलिए वाक्य में 'on a factory​' के प्रयोग को व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही बनाने के लिए 'in a factory​' से प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए।
